name: Red Stone Chamber
description: This is a small, dank, red stone room with faded carvings in its walls. There is one heavy stone door. Light streams in through the window on the opposite wall.

west.exitDescription: Though worn with time, this door is carved of the same stone as the rest of the room. It is unlocked.

east.exitDescriptionOpen: Outside, you see a deadly garden lined with thorny bushes and pungent flowers of dubious origin.
east.exitDescriptionClosed: The clouded glass of this window is bordered on all sides by a smooth stone frame. It is unlatched.

name: Thorny Poisonous Garden
description: You climb out of the window into the deadly, thorny, poisonous garden. On a better day, you might have got away with only a few scratches and a foot full of thorns. Unfortunately for you, this garden is home to a large, hungry, ambulatory plant by the name of Rashflower, and these actions have offered you up as her dinner.

name: Hallway of Torches
description: This is hallway is ensconced with lit torches that flicker and dance in the moving air. Behind you lies the heavy stone door from which you came. Ahead there stands another stone door, marked with a yellow rune.

east.exitDescription: Carved of red stone. This door stands open.

west.exitDescription: Carved of red stone, this door has been painted with a bright yellow rune. It is unlocked.

lookDescriptions.rune: A yellow rune etched into the stone door. It glows faintly.
